title: The interior-vertex lower-bound conjecture for grid pebbling distributions
statement:
Let $P$ be a solvable pebbling distribution on the grid. A vertex is **interior** if it does not lie on the boundary of the grid.

**Interior-vertex lower-bound conjecture.** For every interior vertex $X$,

$$
v(X) \geq \frac{3}{2}.
$$

The conjecture would improve the lower bound used in the paper from $\frac{4}{3}$ to $\frac{3}{2}$ for vertices away from the boundary, potentially yielding a stronger lower bound on the pebbling number of the grid. The source presents it as an open problem motivated by the observation about $2$-reachable vertices.
source_name: Jan Petr, Julien Portier and Szymon Stolarczyk, “A new lower bound on the pebbling number of the grid”, arXiv:2111.13173 (2021).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.13173

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2021).
